crossRefs.note: You shall put the two braided chains of gold in the two rings at the ends of the breastplate.

translations.web: You shall put the two braided chains of gold in the two rings at the ends of the breastplate.
translations.bsb: Then fasten the two gold chains to the two gold rings at the corners of the breastpiece,
translations.kjv: And thou shalt put the two wreathen chains of gold in the two rings which are on the ends of the breastplate.
translations.asv: And thou shalt put the two wreathen chains of gold in the two rings at the ends of the breastplate.
